description: This file implements a lockfile utility for managing file locks, including acquiring, releasing, and updating locks with support for stale lock detection and retries. It uses filesystem operations and signal handling to ensure proper lock management.

methods.name: probe
methods.description: Checks the modification time and its precision for a given file, caching the precision.

methods.name: getMtime
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current time, adjusted for second or millisecond precision.

methods.name: getLockFile
methods.description: Determines the lockfile path based on options.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalPath
methods.description: Resolves the canonical path of a file, optionally resolving symlinks.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to create a lock by making a directory; handles stale lock detection and removal.

methods.name: isLockStale
methods.description: Checks if a lock is stale based on its modification time.

methods.name: removeLock
methods.description: Removes a lock directory, ignoring errors if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: updateLock
methods.description: Periodically updates the lock's mtime to keep it active, handling errors and staleness.

methods.name: setLockAsCompromised
methods.description: Marks a lock as compromised and triggers the onCompromised callback.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Main function to acquire a lock on a file, with retries and lock maintenance.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases a lock on a file.

methods.name: toPromise
methods.description: Wraps callback-based methods into Promise-based ones.

methods.name: ensureCleanup
methods.description: Sets up cleanup to release all locks on process exit.
